builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Poppy: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (493 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 63.1% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: An anti-mobility warden who uses walls and dash denial to keep enemies in unfavorable positions. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Dead Man's Plate → Locket of the Iron Solari → Bandlepipes. Aftershock keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Boots of Swiftness, Celestial Opposition, Knight's Vow.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Dead Man's Plate → Locket of the Iron Solari → Bandlepipes, with Aftershock.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Dead Man's Plate → Locket of the Iron Solari → Bandlepipes) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 63.1% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Dead Man's Plate → Locket of the Iron Solari → Bandlepipes.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Begin Casting: Poppy begins charging her hammer for up to [4] seconds, Slowing herself by [15]%.

Release: Poppy smashes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first champion hit and surrounding enemies, Knocks them Back towards their Nexus, and makes them Untargetable while they fly. The range and Knock Back distance increase with charge duration.

An uncharged swing deals [(200 / 300 / 400 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.5)] physical damage and Knocks Up for [1] seconds.

Passive: Poppy gains [(0.16) × Stat(1)] Armor and [(0.16) × Stat(6)] Magic Resist. This bonus is doubled if Poppy is below [40]% Health.

Active: Poppy gains [40]% Move Speed and projects a field around her for [2] seconds that stops enemy dashes. Enemies who are stopped by the field are Grounded and Slowed by [25]% for [2] seconds and take [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

Poppy smashes the ground, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable. 

The unstable area Slows enemies by [0.2 / 0.23 / 0.26 / 0.29 / 0.32 + (8e-05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and erupts after [1] second, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage again.

Every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 19, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds, Poppy's next Attack throws her buckler, gaining [350] range and dealing an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 180; raw flags preserved)] magic damage. The buckler ricochets off the target, landing nearby. Poppy can pick it up to gain [(characterLevelInterpolation(0.11 → 0.2; raw flags preserved)) × Stat(12)] Shield, and enemies can step on it to destroy it.

The buckler automatically returns to Poppy if it kills the target.

Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for [1.6 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 1.9 / 2] seconds and take an additional [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

builds.name: Buckler return trade
builds.summary: Combine a ranged buckler attack with a shield pickup before reentry.
builds.goal: Combine a ranged buckler attack with a shield pickup before reentry.
builds.hypothesis: The passive attack gains range and a recoverable health-scaled shield. Trinity rewards a preceding cast, Dead Man's discharges on an attack and Sundered Sky tests the first champion attack heal. Visage strengthens recovered shielding/healing; E wall collision can buy pickup time.
testPlan: Required state: Passive ready, spell cast before buckler and an accessible landing point.
Separate buckler attack, item packets and pickup shield while comparing pickup versus forfeiture.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The opponent destroys the buckler or terrain access costs more health than the shield grants.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A ranged buckler attack does not make every Poppy spell an on-hit carrier.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Dead Man's Plate, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Magic matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Poppy: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: An anti-mobility warden who uses walls and dash denial to keep enemies in unfavorable positions. Compare wall-stun reliability and dash denial with physical burst. Shield pickup and passive attack cadence matter; R displacement can remove the target from damage range. MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
builds.summary: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Poppy: Compare wall-stun reliability and dash denial with physical burst. Shield pickup and passive attack cadence matter; R displacement can remove the target from damage range.

Start with the early core (Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.

The route fails Poppy's stated kit question: Compare wall-stun reliability and dash denial with physical burst. Shield pickup and passive attack cadence matter; R displacement can remove the target from damage range.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.
Full cost 15,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Dash gate magic
builds.summary: Concentrate budget on punishing dash attempts through W.
builds.goal: Concentrate budget on punishing dash attempts through W.
builds.hypothesis: W's anti-dash hit has 0.7 AP, while E wall stun or tap R can keep a victim near Abyssal and Zeke. Cosmic reacts to W/passive magic damage; AP improves W without raising Q's percent-health physical term. The route depends on enemies choosing a dash inside W.
testPlan: Required state: Enemy dash available, W field correctly timed and tap R used for local contact.
Compare dash-stop damage and aura contact with tap versus charged R against a scripted dash.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Enemies walk away or hold mobility; charged R removes them from the damage zone.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: More AP does not cause W to hit enemies who never dash.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Cosmic Drive, Abyssal Mask, Zeke's Convergence, Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
